name: Sanblue Corporation Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Sanblue Corporation Ltd is engaged in the trading business.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:
SCL engages in retail, wholesale, export, import, and trading of a wide range of consumer, domestic, and general products, along with merchandise and materials of all kinds. It operates as agents, dealers, distributors, and merchants for commodities such as garments, fabrics, fibres, textiles, yarns, steel, and chemicals. Additionally, the company provides consultancy, technical, and management advisory services independently or in collaboration, in India and abroad.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.61 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 31.6 days to 13.1 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.87% over last 3 years.
